Steps: Launch app; enter registered email; enter correct password; tap Sign in
Expected Result: User is authenticated and dashboard opens
Execution Notes: Observed dashboard screenshot exists; login screen later reports no account for same email, so execution inconsistency is captured as BUG-001

Title: Login with unregistered email
Steps: Enter an email not linked to an account; enter any password; tap Sign in

Expected Result: Authentication fails with a clear invalid-credentials message; no dashboard access
